scope: Development diagnostic from generated validated cuts. Fixed noise without cut labels. No photograph or crop uncertainty. Source cuts are used only to validate and score, never in fitting.

limitations: Floating-point chord-based intersection checks, not exact algebraic predicates.
Samples on a target cut within twice the geometry tolerance have no unambiguous colour and are counted separately.
Forward image sampling supplements the edge-parity and path-topology checks; it is not an exact area comparison.
Cut-error simulation and paper-core analysis are separate from this nominal validator.

criteria.timings: Single native solve/validation/export measurement per track; preparation and independent scoring excluded. Not isolated startup, repeated latency or browser timing.

fullSuite.status: running at collection; not claimed complete

findings: Constant profile extrusion left visible fringe notches; the smooth-row proposal removes them in the shared lattice and frame.
Dense-lattice edges still deviate slightly; radial contour has small irregularities.
Reference error is slightly higher for the lattice and radial motif despite faster observed fitting.
Editable channel gains a small raster discrepancy; all twenty editable candidates still pass original-source/geometry/paper checks.

limitations: Five valid development designs, not a real-photo benchmark or a held-out topology study.
One selected generated source failed physical self-clearance and was retained as rejected, not replaced.
Row prior weight 100 was chosen during development on these inputs.
Four experimental variants were inspected; this is not an unbiased model selection estimate.
Wider border proposals may damage real near-edge motifs; no runtime integration or physical assembly verification.
